package.name: autoware_stuck_recovery_supervisor
package.description:
Watchdog that notices when the robot is permanently stuck behind an obstacle and hands control to a private freespace (hybrid A* / Reeds-Shepp) planner instance long enough to manoeuvre around it.
The supervisor never publishes a trajectory or a velocity command. It only arms the recovery costmap and freespace planner on their own topics, supplies a synthetic goal a few metres ahead, and asks the scenario_selector to switch. The mission route is never cleared, so the robot simply resumes afterwards.
Before acting it measures the free lateral corridor: if the robot does not fit, it stays stopped and raises diagnostics instead of manoeuvring.
